Mismagius

Ghost

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Mismagius is a Ghost-type Magical Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 4.4 kg. It evolves from Misdreavus. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (105), with a base stat total of 495.
